summary: Preview or apply a guarded owner patch, including typed completed-run truth correction, to exactly one canonical execplan.
intent: Support targeted owner mutation, implementation-scaffold tightening, and atomic correction of review-invalidated completed-run truth without delete/recreate behavior, broad plan rewrites, or arbitrary completion-field patching.

inputs.name: completion_correction
inputs.description: Typed semantic correction containing stable identity, admitted review evidence, completion disposition, and linked proposal/target revision guards.

output.description: Targeted execplan writer preview, apply, no-op, rejection, or rollback result.

reads.surface: target repository Planning state and owner records

writes.when: --apply is set and the patch changes the selected owner

steps.description: Resolve one live owner, validate revision guards, derive projection effects, and preview or write atomically.
Emit targeted writer result in the requested format.

guards: one exact canonical owner selected by id/path
preview returns owner/state/lane revisions and changed fields without writes
preview projects the exact delta while apply reruns a sealed internal preflight bound to target/worktree mutation baseline, Planning, owner, lane, request revisions, and expiry
apply rejects caller-built timestamp/lookalike bearer tokens and writes owner/projection updates and the admitted preflight evidence atomically
replay is idempotent only while the recorded owner/state/lane postcondition remains live

scaffold tightening supports goal, non-goals, intent continuity, execution bounds, touched paths, validation commands, completion criteria, and adaptive assurance while preserving canonical projections
completion correction remains a typed semantic mode: ordinary patches cannot directly set execution_run, finished_run_review, intent_satisfaction, execution_summary, or closure_check

completion correction requires stable correction identity, admitted review refs, a material supported source patch, and exact proposal plus target-authority guards when integration-pending truth participates

reopen atomically demotes every completion projection, restores lane work, and rejects the superseded proposal; remain-feature-complete atomically rebuilds completion truth and refreshes proposal currentness
proof: targeted writer CLI preview/apply/replay tests preserve unrelated records and templates
apply without a preview-issued preflight receipt refuses before mutation
forged, cross-target, stale-baseline, owner/lane mutation, and invalidated-replay fixtures
completion-correction fixtures cover reopen, corrected-complete, stale proposal rejection, idempotent replay, unrelated-state preservation, and rollback after a late proposal write
hand-edit lifecycle or lane state without projection effects
